independent_seed_readout.independent_unit: training seed; stable and shock averaged within seed
independent_seed_readout.interpretation: Six condition cells are not six independent training seeds; observed win fractions are not future probabilities.

interpretation.historical_weighting: Each old actor first averages all six fixed environments; all five actor means have equal weight.
interpretation.historical_cell_weighting: Within each environment all five old actors have equal weight; never select a best actor.
interpretation.statistical_unit: Five historical training actors and three v75 training seeds; thirty old days are not thirty independent training replicates.
interpretation.attribution: Cached fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh is preserved. Comparisons with historical final MC-WM rank complete systems with different training budgets and initializers.
interpretation.execution: Historical raw-state F is retained; canonical F is audited passively. Its difference is not asserted to cause the observed degradation.
interpretation.v103: Its fixed-action mean gate closed; history6 causal failure was not tested.
